title: Relative homotopy lifting for a simplicial left fibration
statement: Use simplicial sets, standard simplices and degreewise products of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and left fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], in fixed universes. Let $p:E\to B$ be any small left fibration, let $A\subseteq K$ be any degreewise injective inclusion of small simplicial sets, and put $V=(K\times\{0\})\cup_{A\times\{0\}}(A\times\Delta^1)\subseteq K\times\Delta^1$. Given simplicial maps $u:V\to E$ and $h:K\times\Delta^1\to B$ satisfying $pu=h|_V$, there exists a simplicial map $\widetilde h:K\times\Delta^1\to E$ with $\widetilde h|_V=u$ and $p\widetilde h=h$. No Kan or quasicategory hypothesis on $B,K,A,E$, no nonemptiness hypothesis, and no uniqueness of the lift is imposed.

source.place: Corollary 2.1.2.7, applied to the left horn {0} = Lambda_0^1 in Delta^1 and A in K; equivalently Corollary 2.1.2.10, the homotopy extension lifting property, printed pp.64-65. Read online; not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this simplicial result.
